## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link relevant issues or protocol contracts.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. State what remains untested; distinguish offline tests, builds and actual native client observations.

## Review checks

- [ ] No game binaries/assets, credentials, databases, personal paths or private captures are included.
- [ ] New dependencies retain their upstream notices and provenance.
- [ ] Network or persistence changes include meaningful tests for the affected authority and restart/session boundaries.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the behavior and the evidence actually obtained.
